nominal V/Hz labels versus independently calibrated SI claims
common-grid timing/skew/jitter and analog anti-alias/ADC calibration scope
joint deterministic enclosure OR justified statistical dependence/coverage, without treating100frequencysettings as iid repeats
validated numerical rounding debit separately from acquisition error
physical oscillator model withsqrt(I) amplitude, preparation/source/dissipation histories and justified alternative; missing evidence blocks physical validation
content hashes and structural completeness do not establish evidence truth or reviewer independence
null/MISSING placeholders are not zero error bounds or accepted admissions
